company.shortDescription: BeHomes is a proptech platform simplifying real estate transactions, listings, and property management digitally.
company.description: BeHomes is a proptech platform that streamlines real estate transactions, property listings, and management through digital tools. It connects buyers, sellers, landlords, and agents on a single system, improving transparency and efficiency. BeHomes focuses on simplifying property discovery, documentation, and communication while enabling smoother, tech-enabled real estate operations for residential and commercial markets.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $585,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,065,647 to $4,065,647, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 52 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
